channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
item.description: In an October preprint, authors used GPT-6 Astra to propose a nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, targeting more than 50 years of reliance on perturbation theory that makes even the proton mass hard to calculate directly. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Our new blog for science
item.description: OpenAI launched a science blog where academic researchers share AI-driven discoveries and methods, illustrated by its GPT-Rosalind agent analyzing millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes. (OpenAI News)

item.title: DeepSeek Tightens Usage Limits: 7-Day Chat History, 40,000-Character Input, and Daily Quota Adjustments
item.description: DeepSeek's app and web version now drop conversation history after 7 days of inactivity, cap a single prompt at roughly 40,000 characters, and add a daily chat quota that returns a server-congestion message once used up. (AIbase)

item.title: AI actor Fang Taozi draws 400,000 followers in 30 days since debut — and her first sponsored post comes with a 68,200-yuan fine
item.description: AI virtual actor Fang Taozi gained 400,000 followers in 30 days, but her first paid promotion for colored contact lenses was ruled false advertising because virtual characters lack real usage experience, and the operator was fined over 68,200 yuan. (AIbase)

item.title: Qwen AI platform debuts Qwen4-Max, courting developers with Token usage cut in half and scores up nearly 28%
item.description: Alibaba released Qwen4 on November 16, with the Qwen AI platform launching Qwen4-Max first as a 2.4T-parameter MoE model that cuts same-tier test token use from 289K to 151K while raising scores from 37.9 to 48.5. (AIbase)

item.title: NVIDIA Robotics Learning Engineer Dai Shiqin Resigns Following Jensen Huang's Sudden Departure
item.description: Nvidia robotics learning engineer Darrell Dai is leaving the company, citing Jensen Huang's sudden resignation as CEO on November 12, a departure he calls "especially disappointing" after Huang's early CUDA bet and push into physical AI. (AIbase)

item.title: Volcano Engine has fully opened the Seedance 2.5 4K API, with support for 10-bit color depth and a sample mode.
item.description: Volcano Engine opened the Seedance 2.5 4K API on November 16, adding a 480P Draft mode and 10-bit color depth while explaining how developers can lower trial-and-error costs. (AIbase)

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan releases Hy4flash: 224B parameters, 1M context, decoding over 150 tps, and a per-task cost just 1/13 that of Hy4preview
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan launched Hy4flash on November 16 with 224B total parameters, 12B activated, 1M-token context, over 150tps decoding and per-task cost at 1/13 of Hy4preview. (AIbase)

item.title: Apple teams up with OpenEvidence to launch a health AI research app, with plans to recruit 200,000 users
item.description: Apple and OpenEvidence are launching a health AI research app that will recruit about 200,000 U.S. iPhone 15-or-newer users for a study lasting more than 12 months to evaluate AI-generated health advice grounded in clinical literature. (AIbase)

item.title: ByteAsk Cloud Agents — Find the fix in big codebases. Ship it from Slack.
item.description: ByteAsk Cloud Agents' page promises locating fixes in large codebases and shipping them straight from Slack, but the body serves only a CAPTCHA verification screen, so no product details are actually readable. (Product Hunt)

item.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter — A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
item.description: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter packages 82 Claude Code skills, 15 slash commands and 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices for bug hunting and external red-team work. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Doubao Work launches "Workspace," with a first batch of 21 apps spanning finance, healthcare, education and other scenarios
item.description: Doubao Work's Workspace, launched November 16, spans 21 professional scenarios, letting finance researchers interpret announcements and analyze earnings with Wind access while doctors retrieve clinical guidelines. (AIbase)

item.title: Understanding Positional Embeddings in Modern Large Language Models
item.description: Positional encoding in LLMs shifted from GPT's absolute embeddings to RoPE, explained through visual examples, light math and a small PyTorch implementation, with a closing look at 2026 open-weight model choices. (magazine.sebastianraschka.com)

item.title: All AI-generated code should be open source
item.description: All AI-generated code should be released under Open Source or CC0 licenses, Jakub T. Jankiewicz argues, because models trained on open-source content like Stack Overflow without attribution and purely AI-made code is not human authorship. (jakub.jankiewicz.org)

item.title: "Who is Hiring?" postings stuck near 12-year lows as AI reaches half of all jobs
item.description: "Who is Hiring?" postings stuck near 12-year lows as AI reaches half of all jobs

item.title: Alibaba Qwen releases Qwen4-Max: architecture upgrade cuts token consumption, per-task cost down 58%
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen released Qwen4-Max on November 16 with 2.4T parameters, 71B activated per token and a million-token context, cutting per-task cost 58% with cache priced at 0.5 yuan per million tokens. (AIbase)

item.title: Show HN: db-branch – database branches in seconds for AI agents and CI, via ZFS
item.description: db-branch spins up MySQL database branches in seconds using ZFS clones without copying data, routing through ProxySQL across VMs and clustering with Raft under an Apache-2.0 self-hosted license.

item.title: In 8 months it became the single AI product serving the most tokens in China—yet Tencent's executive office says AI application development has only just begun
item.description: A single AI product became China’s top token provider within eight months, per Tencent Culture’s Nov. 16 28th-anniversary LinkTime article, which also notes the executive committee says AI application development has just begun and stresses self-built compute and ROI. (AIbase)

item.title: Without invoking an image model, Claude Fable5.2 draws a shopping cart in 700,000 brushstrokes
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable5.2, released November 9 alongside Mythos5.2, has no image model to call on, so Jake Eaton's X demo used code to simulate roughly 700,000 brush strokes drawing a parking-lot shopping cart. (AIbase)

item.title: Huawei Cloud to launch CloudRoboWM1.2, its first Ascend-native embodied world model
item.description: Huawei Cloud streams a November 16 launch event from 14:00 to 15:30 to unveil CloudRoboWM1.2, its first Ascend-native embodied world model, alongside a CloudRobo ecosystem co-building plan. (AIbase)
